name: Rozelle Hostel
description:
Rozelle Hostel is not a new Hostel to the city of Sidney however we are currently being renovated into an entirely brand new hostel with a new name in an inner west city suburb of Sydney - opening its doors to backpackers around the world who are looking for a safe, clean, social, and very fun hostel to call home while exploring Sydney's amazing culture, beautiful weather, and all the fun things a backpacker would enjoy. 

Situated just 3 k's from the city center and all of the wonderful attractions the city has to offer such as the Opera House, Museums, Botanical Gardens, Hyde Park etc. which guests can access through any number of many frequent buses operating 24/7 along with the numerous bustling shops, banks, post office, supermarkets and much much more literally within walking distance of the hostel.

Balmain Beach, the beautiful "King George" park, the stunningly beautiful paramatta river and tributary areas and many other wonderful attractions are simply a walking distance from the hostel and various other famed beaches such as Bondi beach and Manly beach are also close by, by the very same easy to get public transport buses just outside our door.

We also offer free WiFi all throughout the hostel.

Our hostel is open 24/7 but our management office and reception for new check-ins is limited. Our office hours are 10AM through 6PM daily, and our check-in hours are 1PM (1300 hours) through 6PM (1800 hours) ONLY as we are NOT staffed for early morning or late night check-ins

lastly but most certainty not least, PLEASE NOTE: while we love to have parties and a big bunch of fun, and we do like big groups as well, our hostel does NOT accept multiple bookings under ONE name and or ONE credit card which very simply means that we want you to come stay with us but we expect EACH individual wanting to book a stay at our hostel to book their OWN bed using their OWN credit card instead of booking two or more people under the name of just one person using one credit card. 

We STILL offer LIMITED (3 spaces) free underground parking available to all guest that stay with us on a first come first serve bases.

houseRules.notes:
Rozelle Hostel Terms and Conditions:

- Please note that all reservations with check-in dates between December 17 and January 3 must be paid in full in advance. This policy is in place to help us manage high seasonal demand and reduce the risk of last-minute cancellations during our busiest time of year.

Guests should be prepared to complete full payment upon booking during this period. Reservations that are not paid in full may be subject to cancellation.

In order to make your stay a fine, safe and memorable one, these are the rules: 

1. Pay your rent in advance at all times.
2. Keep clean and tidy in your room, kitchen and all common areas.
3. Room cleaning and making beds will be done during checking out and checking in times
4. Stealing is an Australian Criminal Offence.
5. Absolutely NO SMOKING of any substance nor Prohibited Drugs within all areas of the premises. All internal areas of these premises are Smoke Free Environment. 
6. Tampering with and/or damaging any part of the premises including signs is prohibited.
7. Setting off the Fire Alarm falsely will incur a fine in excess of $2000 with your name written on the bill.
8. All online bookings must be paid in full upon arrival. If you cancel or are a no show within our 24 hour policy, you will be charged your first nights stay.
9. Keep clean and Label your bags in the common fridges. Remove them when checking out. 
10. Visitors are NOT allowed in the rooms. You may bring a visitor to the common lounge from 10 am to 10 pm. You MUST accompany your Visitor at all times and they MUST leave at the direction of the Management.
11. Avoid confrontation with others. Direct your complain to management to obtain satisfactory result. Aggressive behaviour will NOT be tolerated.
12. Intoxication, abusive behaviour and messy people will be evicted.
13. Obey the directions given to you by the management of all businesses within 	these premises. We take complains from other staff within these premises very seriously and act upon it immediately.
14. We LOVE and respect our neighbours. Keep clean and quiet around the outside of these premises and DO NOT through any object out of the building.
15. Only one person per single bed.
16. We required 3 minimum nights stay for every room type. 

Should you disobey these rules you will be evicted immediately without refund and you may be criminally charged depending on the nature of your offence.

While we strive to provide the best hospitality and facilities for you. Management reserve the right to enter any room and evict any guest with or without reason at any time.

We thank you for staying with us and we hope that you are having a great time.


Check in Time: From 1 pm until 6 pm 
Check out time: 10 am everyday
If you check out after this time you may be charged an extra night.

Our hostel is open 24/7 but our management office and reception for new check-ins is limited.
